overview_description.description:
Progyny (Nasdaq: PGNY) is a leading fertility benefits management company. We are redefining fertility and family building benefits, proving that a comprehensive and inclusive solution can simultaneously benefit employers, patients, and physicians. 
 
Our benefits solution empowers patients with education and guidance from a dedicated Patient Care Advocate (PCA), provides access to a premier network of fertility specialists using the latest science and technologies, reduces healthcare costs for the nation’s leading employers, and drives optimal clinical outcomes. We envision a world where anyone who wants to have a child can do so.
 
Headquartered in New York City, Progyny has been recognized for its leadership and growth by CNBC Disruptor 50, Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare, Financial Times, INC. 5000, and Crain’s Fast 50 for NYC. For more information, visit www.progyny.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Progyny is a fertility benefits management company.

product.name: Progyny Fertility and Family Building
product.description: An employer-sponsored benefit covering fertility care and family-building pathways such as preconception planning, IVF, IUI, egg freezing, adoption, and surrogacy.

product.name: Pregnancy and Postpartum Care
product.description: A women’s health benefit supporting pregnancy, postpartum recovery, maternal care, and return-to-work planning through clinical guidance, care coordination, and member support.

product.name: Progyny Global
product.description: A multinational women’s health and family-building benefits solution providing fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, and menopause support across countries in locally compliant formats and multiple languages.

product.name: Progyny Select
product.description: A fully insured supplemental fertility and family-building plan for small and midsized employers, providing access to Progyny’s fertility benefit model without requiring a large employer-sponsored program.

product.name: Menopause and Midlife Care
product.description: A benefit supporting menopause and midlife health through access to specialists, symptom-management guidance, education, and care coordination for employees and health-plan members.

product.name: Parenting and Child Well-being
product.description: A family health benefit supporting parents and children with guidance and resources related to parenting, child well-being, and care needs after family formation.
